description: This PHP source file defines the ReportingMethodConfigurationAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing reporting methods in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting reporting methods, along with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing reporting methods, including CRUD operations and validation within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reporting method by ID, throws RecordNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all reporting methods with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new reporting method based on request data.

methods.name: saveReportingMethod
methods.description: Helper method to create or update a ReportingMethod entity from request parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing reporting method identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes reporting methods specified by IDs, ensuring they are not in use.
